test_results.question: What major acquisition did NVIDIA discuss or complete in its fiscal year 2020 annual report?
test_results.answer:
In its fiscal year 2020 annual report, NVIDIA discussed the acquisition of Mellanox [NVIDIA 2020 Annual Report (Form 10-K), Page 8]. 

Key details regarding the acquisition discussed in the report include:
* Mellanox is based in Israel and will serve as one of NVIDIA's most significant design centers [NVIDIA 2020 Annual Report (Form 10-K), Page 8].
* NVIDIA received approval from all necessary regulatory agencies to proceed with the acquisition [NVIDIA 2020 Annual Report (Form 10-K), Page 8].
* The acquisition was expected to close on or about April 27, 2020 [NVIDIA 2020 Annual Report (Form 10-K), Page 8].
